cŏlumnātus , a, um, adj. id.,
I.supported by posts or pillars (perh. only in the foll. exs.): “tholus,” Varr. R. R. 3, 5, 12 : “diversoria, Ambros. de Cain et Abel, 1, 5, 19: pons,” Ampel. Lib. Mem. 8, 3 .—Humorously: “os,” i. e. supported upon the hand, Plaut. Mil. 2, 2, 57 ; cf. id. ib. 2, 2, 54.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
